# Cosimo by Medici & Company

> Fund operations software that helps fund teams prepare draft investor reports, portfolio updates, and replies from the records they already keep.

## Product

Cosimo is the product. Medici & Company is the company. Workflows are configured and tested with the fund team around its sources, reporting format, and review process. The team checks the draft, resolves open questions, and approves the final version.

## Website pages

- [All funds](/): Reporting, portfolio updates, and investor requests; an interactive quarterly portfolio-update example.
- [Real estate](/re/): LP reports, investor statements, capital call notices, and distribution notices.
- [Venture capital](/vc/): Founder updates, portfolio metrics, cash and runway, and LP reporting.
- [Private equity](/pe/): Company actuals and budgets, variance commentary, portfolio packs, and LP reporting.
- [Private credit](/credit/): Borrower review packs, covenant worksheets, reporting follow-ups, and LP updates.
- [Hedge funds](/hedge/): Investor letters, close exceptions, investor activity, and allocator response drafts.
- [FAQ](/faq.html): What the product does, how the examples work, and how to start.
- [About](/about.html): Product and company information.
- [Extended description](/llms-full.txt): More detail on the proposed workflows and examples.

## Examples and claim boundaries

The website uses fictional fund records and prewritten outputs, not live product runs or customer results. Source links open sample records. The examples do not establish measured time savings, integration coverage, audit readiness, security certification, or guaranteed turnaround. Fund-specific configuration and testing are required. The team retains review and approval.

## Start with one process

Email info@medici.ai with what your team prepares, where the information comes from, and which part takes the most time. Medici & Company works through a first workflow to test with the team. Scope and commercial terms are agreed before starting; no fixed pilot duration or price is offered on these pages.

Website: https://medici.ai
